name: bec-gift-card
description: Executive gift-card scam: CEO impersonation from a freemail account, availability probe, secrecy request, gift-card ask, no links at all.

email.subject: Quick favour
email.bodyText:
Are you available at the moment?

I need you to handle something for me discreetly. I'm currently in a meeting with the board and cannot take calls, so email only please.

We need to send out client appreciation gifts today and I would like you to purchase 8 Amazon gift cards at 250 each. Once you have them, scratch off the back and send me photographs of the codes so I can forward them on before end of day.

Please keep this between us for now as I want to announce it at the all-hands on Friday. I will get finance to reimburse you as soon as I'm out.

Let me know as soon as it's done.

Regards,
Daniel Achebe
Chief Executive Officer
Sent from my iPhone
